description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'TaxonomyIndexTid' that extends 'ManyToOne' filter, used for filtering taxonomy terms by term id within Drupal views. It includes methods for constructing the filter, building form options, validating input, and managing dependencies, specifically for taxonomy term filtering in Drupal.

classes.name: TaxonomyIndexTid
classes.description: A Drupal Views filter plugin class for filtering taxonomy terms by term id, supporting options for vocabulary, hierarchy, and input validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the filter with storage interfaces and current user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the filter with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, setting vocabulary options if defined.

methods.name: hasExtraOptions
methods.description: Indicates that this filter has extra configuration options.

methods.name: getValueOptions
methods.description: Returns the current value options for the filter.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the filter such as type, limit, vocabulary id, hierarchy, and error message.

methods.name: buildExtraOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for extra filter options, including vocabulary selection and display type.

methods.name: valueForm
methods.description: Builds the form elements for selecting taxonomy terms, either via autocomplete or hierarchy/tree.

methods.name: valueValidate
methods.description: Validates the selected term IDs from the form input.
